answer.reason: A "slider" on this instance is the Carousel component (reference name "carousel"). Its "Slides" field is a nested grid of the "carouselSlide" content model (Carousel Slide), so a new slide belongs in carouselSlide. Its fields (Heading, Description, Background Image, Call To Action, CTA Text Override) cover a product screenshot slide. The Carousel Slide model is nested under the Carousel component's Slides field, so the new item is added as a child of that component rather than as a standalone list item. Other candidates such as Bento Card, Gallery Image, and Feature Item are used by other components, not the slider.
